cards.hint: Think about what balances weight in level flight
options: lift is equal to the weight
cards.quote: in which the lift is equal to the weight, and the thrust is equal to the drag.
cards.stem: In level cruise, what vertical force balance holds steady

cards.hint: Focus on the total push and pull acting on the plane
cards.quote: Since there is no net external force on the aircraft, the aircraft maintains a constant airspeed
cards.stem: Why does a cruising airplane keep the same airspeed

cards.hint: Think about which side pulls harder
cards.quote: However, if the forces become unbalanced, the aircraft moves in the direction of the greater force.
cards.stem: When forces are unbalanced, where does the aircraft go

cards.hint: Recall the rate equation linking speed and duration aloft
options: ground speed times the time aloft
cards.quote: the distance flown is equal to the ground speed times the time aloft.
cards.stem: What product gives how far a cruising aircraft flies
